an4.80:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an4.80:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :--
an4.80:2.1: Ko nu bhante hetu ko paccayo yena mātugāmo n' eva sabhāya nisīdati na kammantaṃ payojeti na kammojaṃ gacchati?
an4.80:2.6: Ayaṃ kho Ānanda hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena mātugāmo n' eva sabhāya nisīdati na kammantaṃ payojeti na kammojaṃ gacchatīti
an4.80:3.4: acintitaṃ dakkhiṇāya vaṇijjā kammojena ca vaggo ti 81. 1.
